title: ENS2DNS
tagline: I want to have a look at the ENS resolver contract. How can it be used in a scenario with webhosting by a decentralised compute marketplace/network
description:
The plan was a look at the ENS resolver contract. How can it be used in a scenario with webhosting by a decentralized compute marketplace/network when using traditional DNS A records to IP addresses rather than using contentadressed storage networks. 

I had to learn a lot about DNS workings in general and  explore the existing solutions out there. 

eth.lino, eth.link, dweb.link (brave) only facilitate the route to contenthashes on ipfs, not the load balancing/round robin of ip adresses i was looking for. 

I tried to find a workaround, but to no avail. Learned a lot, though!
